 Writer Haryanti Puspa Sari | Editor Danu Damarjati 
 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) summoned Bagus Wahyudyono, a staff member of the Regional People's Representative Council (DPRD) of East Java, who is a suspect in a corruption case, for questioning by investigators on Monday (16/11/2026).
 “The interrogation will take place at the KPK 's Red and White Building,” KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo stated in a press release today.
 Bagus Wahyudyono is a suspect in the alleged corruption related to the management of grant funds for community groups (pokmas) in East Java Province for the fiscal years 2019-2022.
 However, Budi did not provide further details regarding Bagus's attendance or potential detention plans.
 East Java Grant Fund Case
 On October 2, 2025, the KPK named 21 suspects in a corruption case involving the receipt of gifts or promises related to the management of grant funds for community groups (pokmas) from the East Java Provincial Budget for the fiscal years 2021-2022.
 At that time, the Acting Deputy for Enforcement and Execution of the KPK, Asep Guntur Rahayu, mentioned that among the four suspects receiving bribes are Kusnadi (Chairman of the East Java DPRD); Achmad Iskandar (Vice Chairman of the East Java DPRD); Anwar Sadad (Vice Chairman of the East Java DPRD); and Bagus Wahyudyono (Staff of a DPRD member).
 There are also seventeen suspects who allegedly provided bribes, including Mahud (Member of the East Java DPRD 2019-2024); Fauzan Adima (Vice Chairman of the Sampang DPRD 2019-2024); Jon Junadi (Vice Chairman of the Probolinggo DPRD 2019-2024); Ahmad Affandy, Ahmad Heriyadi, Abdul Motollib (private individuals from Semarang); Moch Mahrus (private individual from Probolinggo); A Royan and Wawan Kristiawan (private individuals from Tulungagung); Ra Wahid Ruslan and Mashudi (private individuals from Bangkalan); M. Fathullah and Achmad Yahya (private individuals from Pasuruan); Ahmad Jailani (private individual from Sumenep); Hasanuddin (private individual from Gresik); Jodi Pradana Putra (private individual from Blitar); and Sukar (a village head from Tulungagung District).
 Asep stated that of the 21 suspects, five were detained today for 20 days at the KPK Detention Center, Red and White Building.
 Those detained by the KPK include the bribers to East Java DPRD Chairman Kusnadi, namely Hasanuddin, Jodi Pradana Putra, Sukar, and Wawan Kristiawan.
 “These four suspects will be held for the first 20 days starting from October 2 until October 21, 2025, at the KPK Detention Center, Red and White Building,” he said.
